column3: Deterministically composes an answer draft (JSON/MD/HTML + graph) from grouped TRACE-Net search results.
Builds citation-backed draft claims from a source-resolved context pack; a deterministic answer/claim composer.
Composes an engineering answer from a context pack's proof/guidance records with a citation quality gate.
Post-composer that rewrites the engineering answer by detected question intent (interchangeability, limits, comparison).
Deterministic fast answer composer from anchor-aware context (direct/variant/neighbor evidence) with violation checks.
Deterministic composer that builds a cited answer for part-family questions from cached context records.
Orchestrates the planner -> context-pack -> composer engineering pipeline and rolls up stage quality.
Single-command question lookup that matches a question to an already-gated draft; controlled pipeline entry point.
Builds engineering reasoning playbooks, example cards, intent plans, and query-plan templates that drive the question pipeline.
Converts approved draft packets into Ollama/OpenAI-compatible Gemma request payloads (no calls sent).
Builds stricter/shorter Gemma retry request payloads for drafts blocked by the final gate.
Executes Gemma draft request payloads against the local endpoint and saves draft responses.
Laptop-safe runner that calls Gemma via Ollama to generate V2 page-summary guidance cards.
Canonical shared parser/renderer/validator for the public Answer/Evidence/Limits contract; imported by the renderers.
Deterministic Answer/Evidence/Engineering-confidence/Limits engineer answer contract and evidence-mode text.
Runtime overlay rendering clean ChatGPT-style per-route public answers, hiding internal telemetry.
Follow-on presentation overlay fixing dedup/table/nomenclature/procedure rendering of public answers.
Narrow presentation overlay re-rendering part-search routes to fix uncited/nomenclature-relevance issues.
Runtime overlay rendering user-facing route views (navigation/OCR/authority/claims) and sanitizing internal tokens.
Runtime overlay with per-route public renderers (guided part/ATA/nomenclature/visual) using the public answer contract.
Runtime overlay rendering deterministic capabilities and IPL field-status public answers for OpenWebUI.
Runtime overlay classifying the evidence-aware answer mode and deterministically rendering non-direct modes.
Runtime overlay adding an exact-page answer mode that renders a deterministic fallback from the requested page pack.
Runtime overlay reconstructing per-route answer content (ATA/table/procedure/visual) from selected claim-ready evidence.
Runtime overlay making one constrained Gemma call to reword the deterministic answer via a strict JSON packet.
Preservation-first overlay that patches the constrained Gemma writer to make it copy Phase 3 answer lines exactly.
